lines.text: When the sea turns, the taps are at risk.
BlueBan eight-one-three watches every Sentinel-2 pass since 2017.
Five thousand and eighty images. Ten areas.
Satellites flag it. An analyst decides. The field confirms. The model learns.
Like this bloom-like patch off Fujairah.
BlueBan eight-one-three. Early warning for the water in front of the UAE's intakes.
